mo_ta_cong_viec:
EPAM Vietnam is looking for a highly motivated Senior Test Automation Engineer to join our Quality team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a top global client, where you’ll apply your technical expertise and collaboration skills to deliver high-quality solutions. You’ll leverage both manual and automated testing techniques throughout the software development lifecycle.
 
At EPAM, engineering is in our DNA. When you join our team, you’ll solve complex problems, build impactful technology solutions and have the support you need to continuously grow your career.
 
Apply today and be eligible for a one-month sign-on bonus. Terms & Conditions apply.
 
Deliver test automation and test automation frameworks
Define test automation approaches, measure effectiveness and perform test automation tool evaluations
Manually execute test cases across different functionalities, logging all identified defects and bugs in the tracking system
Perform exploratory testing to identify potential issues not covered in pre-defined test cases
Amend test cases and test steps to ensure they are up-to-date based on the application’s current version
Prepare the necessary test data (if applicable) and maintain a test data bank to ensure sufficient data is available for multiple scenario-based testing
Participate in usability testing sessions to identify usability issues and suggest improvements
Prepare detailed test reports with clear documentation of test execution results, defect logs and regression testing coverage
Participate in client activities, including phone conferences, workshops and presentations.
yeu_cau:
At least 3 years of Software Testing and/or Test Automation experience, dealing with complex technical issues and tasks
Advanced in test automation using test automation frameworks in Java/ JavaScript/ Python / .Net and related tools
Strong knowledge of Agile methodology and Test Automation processes
Ability to independently establish, follow and enhance test automation process from scratch
Strong cross-functional thinking and problem-solving skills
Understanding or exposure to fixed-time delivery processes and execution
Proficiency in both spoken and written English (B2)
